narrative: An employee was working from a 15-foot-high scissor lift, replacing lightbulbs along a ceiling. An overhead crane struck the scissor lift, causing it to tip over. Its basket fell onto a table on the floor, then ejected the employee; the employee suffered a broken elbow, a possibly broken arm, a broken collarbone, and a head injury.

An employee was spray-painting the ceiling and upper walls of a dock area. He was working from a heavy-duty plastic utility storage bin/box placed on the forks of a forklift. The box shifted, tossing him to the concrete floor about 9 feet below. He suffered broken ribs.

exposure: tossing him to the concrete floor about 9 feet below
barrier_failure: working from a heavy-duty plastic utility storage bin/box placed on the forks of a forklift

narrative: An employee was trying to unattach the hook from a lifting "eye" on the top of a compressor after it was moved when his pinky fingertip was caught and amputated between the hook and the "eye."
An employee was running the steam flaking machine and amputated four fingers on the right hand.

An employee was preparing to clean a press machine and had raised the access door when the door fell and amputated the employee's right index and middle fingers. The press machine was not locked/tagged out at the time.

An employee was replacing a wire rope on an elevator. A pair of wire rope cutters were on the counterweight. When he started the elevator, the wire rope cutters fell on his foot, causing a fracture and laceration that required surgery.
An employee was working under a truck. The truck fell off its lift and pinned the employee, who suffered broken ribs.
An employee was helping a delivery driver move the dock plate by hand. The driver let go of the dock plate and it fell onto the employee's hand and amputated a finger.
An employee was changing light fixtures when he was shocked by the attached wires.
An employee was stepping down from a freezer truck to deliver frozen food to a store. He tripped and fell, fracturing his lower left leg.
